What does sundarisilks.com tell AI shopping agents?

Yes: UCP profile found Yes. In ShopBot Index's crawl of 2026-10-19, sundarisilks.com published a UCP profile at /.well-known/ucp declaring 11 capabilities including checkout: the machine-readable profile AI shopping agents read.
